Name: (CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Greenhouse
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=4][b](v.1.1.0 UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] [/b]is now a hard dependency. Please download the latest version [i]and [/i]perform a clean install of this mod.)
-[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Cozy Rustic Greenhouse [/b]is a modern rustic greenhouse redesign with a neat, customizable layout and a seasonal panoramic background. Choose between three greenhouse sizes and tweak it to your liking![/size][/center]
[center][size=4]-[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]🌿 This mod is a part of the [b]Cozy Rustic Interior Suite! 🌿[/b][/center]
[center]Find the rest of the series: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30714]Kitchen [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Farmhouse [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30070]Cellar [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30170]Greenhouse [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46144]Shed[/url][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]🌿 Need matching [b]Cozy Rustic Furniture?[/b] 🌿[/center]
[center]Find them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Buildable Kitchen[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33318]Bakery n' Cafe[/url][/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*]﻿[b]Native Recolor Support: [/b]Has recolor options to match [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿[/b], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085][b]Starblue Valley[/b][/url][b]﻿ [/b]and the Oak Saloon swatch from[b] [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1184314-asters-beam-and-kitchen-mod-for-farm-building-interiors/comments]Aster's Beam Mod[/url] [/b](NEW in v.1.1.0!)[/*]
[*][b]Size options:[/b] The greenhouse comes in 3 different sizes, and the bigger sizes can be further modified if you want to use it as machine space or to decorate.[/*]
[*][b]Highly customizable: [/b]Visual AND gameplay tweaks for the greenhouse, for free. See the [b]Config Options [/b]section for more details.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in lighting: [/b]The greenhouse walls have built-in sconces that automatically light up at night and during rainy weather.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[b]Greenhouse Basics
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]The greenhouse comes in 3 sizes: [b]Standard, Bigger, Biggest.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]The [b]Standard[/b] greenhouse is slightly bigger than the Vanilla greenhouse, fitting a total of 16 Quality Sprinklers and 16 Fruit Trees.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]The [b]Bigger[/b] and [b]Biggest[/b] greenhouses add a nook to the right side, which contains an extra crop plot with a base capacity of 2 Quality Sprinklers and 4 Quality Sprinklers, respectively.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]The extra crop plots in the [b]Bigger [/b]and [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouses can be toggled off OR changed to a larger size via config, to a capacity of 4 Quality Sprinklers and 2 Iridium Sprinklers, respectively.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b]Water Features[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]The [b]Bigger [/b]and [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouses have additional water features in the side area that can be modified to your liking.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]For the [b]Bigger [/b]greenhouse, you can choose between a fountain OR a water trough, or toggle it off entirely via config.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]For the [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouse, you can choose between a separate fountain, a combined fountain, OR a water trough via config. You can have the water trough WITH the separate fountain, but if you choose the combined fountain, the water trough will be unavailable.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]These modifications are mostly for cosmetic reasons, but [b]you can refill your watering can in the water features in all three greenhouse sizes.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Greenhouse Recolor: [/b]Changes custom tilesheet color to match your interior recolor mod.[/*]
[*][b]Greenhouse Panorama: [/b]Changes the panorama background type. Choose between [b]Forest [/b]or [b]Beach [/b]panorama.[/*]
[*][b]Greenhouse Size: [/b]Toggles the greenhouse size. Default [b]Standard.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Extra Crop Plot Size: [/b]Toggles the size of the extra crop plot in the [b]Bigger [/b]and [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouse sizes.[/*]
[*][b]Water Source: [/b]Toggles the type of water source in the [b]Bigger [/b]greenhouse size.[/*]
[*][b]Fountain Shape: [/b]Toggles the type of fountain in the [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouse size.[/*]
[*][b]Water Trough: [/b]Toggles the water trough in the [b]Biggest [/b]greenhouse size. [b]Will not take effect if Fountain Shape is set to 'Combined'.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[size=3][b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following mods that affect interior recolors: [b]VPR, Earthy Interiors, Starblue, Rustic Country Town Interior (Dark, Light)[/b].[/size]

[size=3][b][u]Partially Compatible[/u][/b] with [b]Aster's Beam Mod[/b] for the following swatch: [b]OakSaloon. [/b]This matches the Vanilla 'Dark Oak' used in cellars and certain town interiors.[/size]

[size=3][u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with any mod that modifies Maps/Greenhouse.[/size]

[b]I will not add recolor compatibility with mods other than the ones mentioned in the above section.[/b] If you want to add an unsupported recolor, contact me first. Uploading a recolor compatibility to this mod as a separate mod on Nexus or any other platform is strictly prohibited.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Let's Move It[/b] (not required, but recommended for moving crops if you are installing this mod into an ongoing save).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Greenhouse" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Have fun![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]If you install this mod into an existing save where the greenhouse has been unlocked, any existing crops and items you have in the greenhouse will be in the wrong spots. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url]﻿ to be able to move your crops easier.[/*]
[*]You cannot decorate the glass walls of the greenhouse. To be able to do so like in the previews, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url]﻿.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]I only respond to bug reports that are properly submitted to the Bugs section and not in Posts. Do follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/size][/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Credits to Aimon for the inspiration from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url] and the foreground windows.

A special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Sharogg?gameId=1303]Sharogg[/url]﻿ for helping me diagnose bugs, and an special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ClairesStoryofSeasons]Claire [/url]and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Teaiscoldagain]Lina [/url]for all the support during the making of the Cozy Rustic series!

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/vikich3rry]vikich3rry[/url] for helping me with the RCTI Dark base, which allowed me to push the new RCTI compatibility patch even sooner than planned!

Downloads.Description:
DO A CLEAN INSTALL OF THIS MOD.

- Updated tilesheet assets.
- Added config i18n support.
- Added Aster's OakSaloon compatibility.
- Changed built-in lighting system to fully use MMAP's Light and LightCond actions.
